title: Threat-to-accountability crosswalk
description: Schema for data/threats.json obligation links. These rows are the ROCA Risk records. A link needs a basis and a source. derived_via_control is kept so a map can draw it dashed. It does not claim the legal text names the risk.

source.description: For derived_via_control, source.controls lists the related control, the mapping key, and the citation string. For official_text, source.url and source.citation name the official text, and the text states the harm. For named_citation, source.citation plus source.url or source.document name the document. A named_citation link is derived: the requirement states a duty that addresses the risk, the text does not state the harm, and the link does not run through a control.
